heading: Red-carpet expertise, everyday language.
paragraphs: Anya grew up in the Bay Area, moved to Los Angeles for USC, then polished her eye at Parsons School of Design. Today, she heads Styled By Anya Inc., dressing stars for the Oscars, Golden Globes, and Emmys, while breaking down red carpet trends for television audiences on KTLA, Entertainment Tonight, and Extra.

Her influence stretches far beyond the red carpet. She has shaped major brands as the Chief Accessories Stylist for ShoeDazzle and Fashion Director for YouCeleb, earning accolades like “Best Fashion Stylist for TV” at the POSHGLAM Awards. A trusted media voice, Anya has written for Us Weekly and OK!, hosted events for Diane von Furstenberg, and taken the stage as a TEDx speaker. Passionate about mentoring the next generation, she also teaches styling at FIDM and guest lectures at USC.
Through it all, her point of view remains simple: great style should be exciting and approachable, and a stylist with a big personality is allowed to have fun with it.
